brief:
London Metropolitan Police warned that anyone attending or organizing a Palestine Action demonstration near the US Embassy on Saturday will face arrest, Middle East Eye reported. The police did not specify the legal grounds for the threatened arrests or provide details about the planned protest size or timing.

The warning marks an escalation in police responses to pro-Palestine activism in the capital. Palestine Action has staged multiple demonstrations at UK government and diplomatic sites in recent months.

title: Metropolitan Police threatens arrest for Palestine Action protest near US Embassy
